card.name: Last word of a table header
card.fires_on: The final word of a table title or column heading in flattened label text, right before the table's first row or next column begins. Often a word like Suspension, Injection, Step, Severity or Requirement.

modes.label: Column heading end
modes.description: Last word of a column heading just before the row data starts.

modes.label: Table title end
modes.description: Last word of a table caption or header, followed by the first cell.

modes.label: Split word in heading
modes.description: Ending piece of a heading word that is split into parts.
